items.title: Tesla (TSLA) Secures Long Term Power Deals And Expands Optimus Teleoperation
items.summary: Tesla (NasdaqGS:TSLA) has signed multiple long term renewable energy power purchase agreements, including a deal in Arizona with a KKR backed solar and battery project. The company has also agreed a long term power purchase arrangement in Texas with Zelestra for the Lumen Farm solar project. Tesla’s Optimus humanoid robot unit has acquired Virtuix’s Omni One Enterprise system, expanding its capabilities in robotics teleoperation.
